verifier.rule: goodput@99 per case: highest Poisson rate with >= 99% of requests meeting TTFT p99 and per-token limits at once

experiments.hypothesis: Rows that overflow the full lane go to the Transformers side cohort and collapse per-token time; queue them for a lane slot instead.
Open-loop runs are queue-bound at 16 slots while per-token time has headroom; double the slot pool.
reasons: miss moves from queueing to per-token time

experiments.hypothesis: Admitting at most every 3 decode steps batches arrivals into fewer packed prefills.
reasons: no goodput gain in any case

experiments.hypothesis: Admitting at most every 6 decode steps batches arrivals into fewer packed prefills.
Pace admission only while the lane holds >= 8 rows to keep light-load TTFT.
reasons: light-load TTFT p99 back to 47-54 ms

experiments.hypothesis: Pace admission only while the lane holds >= 16 rows.
11 ms of host work per spec step at 28 rows leaves the GPU idle; launch step N+1 before step N's host work.
reasons: every curve improved, no case crossed its next rate

experiments.hypothesis: At 12 req/s the lane holds 27 of 32 slots (Little's law ~28); add slots.
reasons: interactive miss moves to per-token time

experiments.hypothesis: The banked GDN kernel takes 10.9 of 37 ms at 48 rows (1 MB read + 2 MB write of fp32 state per row-layer); write only token 2's state, rebuild token 1's for rejects.
56 of 240 interactive misses at 12 req/s are TTFT from pacing waits (~234 ms); pace every 3 steps.
